replacements.reason: Headless IfAll.dat scene models are unavailable by deliberate interface-scope exclusion (headless startup omits ifStatus model init, same precedent as the ifmagnify adaptation), so e->x14 is NULL and HSD_JObjLoadJoint(e->x14->joint) segfaults on any indexed match banner (READY/GO/GAME!/TIME OVER via ifStatus_802F7034 indices 0/5/6/7 and unkB-1). Reproducer: 43843c48 game-end banner 6EA4(5) SIGSEGV at 0x08077346 after native frame 11311; gdb confirms all eight scene-model pointers NULL from scene load. The guard skips only the JObj/GObj presentation reconstruction when the model is absent, after unlinking any stale banner exactly as the source does, and records the NULL owner plus the requested callbacks so later free/poll paths see the documented empty state. No gameplay consumer is affected: ifStatus_802F7034 passes NULL callbacks, banner SFX/audio is headless-stubbed, banner anim procs only drive presentation and completion callbacks, and the gm_16AE match-flow callbacks that carry real flow never fire in headless runs (zero hits across an 11311-frame intro-to-gameover trace). Console behavior with models present is unchanged (guard not taken).
